iommus.reason: see t8122.json dart_phandle_field; ADT summary did not preserve the iommu-parent phandle.

interrupts.src: S1 (5 interrupts in ADT; 4 doorbells + ane ring)

ane_cpu_count.src: S1 (T6030 has a single ANE; no ane1/ane2 nodes in j514s/j516s ADTs)

name.src: S2 (BuildManifest: t6030 j514sap/j516sap ANE=t603x_ane0_fw_erebus_ls5x.im4p; the 'ls5x' suffix is the J514s/J516s board-id pattern)

sha256.src: S2 (HTTP range-read macOS 27.0 IPSW member Firmware/ane/t603x_ane0_fw_erebus_ls5x.im4p; IM4P payload is 1605632-byte Mach-O, SHA256 after unwrap; no raw bytes retained)

format.src: S2 (DER fields IM4P/anef/1; payload begins cffaedfe)
